newsitem.title: CANADA: TransAlta hires former Alberta treasurer.
newsitem.headline: TransAlta hires former Alberta treasurer.

text.p: TransAlta Corp, which operates Alberta's biggest electrical utility, said on Thursday it appointed former Alberta provincial treasurer Jim Dinning as its vice-president of corporate development.

Dinning, who retired from Alberta politics in March after 11 years in various Conservative party governments, was known as a key force behind the province's drastic program of spending cuts which helped it to four consecutive budget surpluses.
He said in September, when announcing he would not seek re-election this year, a job in the private sector was likely in the cards.
"Jim will apply his considerable skills primarily to the area of business development," TransAlta chief executive Steve Snyder said in a statement. ((Reuters Calgary Bureau (403) 531-1624))
